HOW TO RACE
🧩 Solve puzzles to earn fuel ⛽
🎡 Pick a multiplier, then tap BLAST to spin the wheel · it shows how far you’ll fly (a lap is 100) · the gold 🚀 is the jackpot
📦 Every 3–5 laps the mystery cube opens (3–7 laps after 200 laps, 3–15 after 400) · coins, fuel or a mega boost
☄️ Every 30 laps an asteroid blocks your rocket · keep blasting it to smash through (no laps while it’s there)
🏁 Most laps after 3 days wins 7,000 gold · 2nd gets 2,323 gold · 3rd gets 1,000 gold
🧊 Then the ships cool down for 2 weeks

    How to Catventure

    • 🧩
      Where to earn paws: the logic puzzle on any of your islands · only once both seats are filled and your tour is on · the paw counter shows at the bottom of the puzzle
    • 🐾
      Every 3rd cat gives +10, every 5th +50, every 10th +100
    • 🎲
      Pick a multiplier, then tap the bubble to roll 3 dice · a pair gives +50%, a triple ×2
    • 🪧
      Your points fill each keepsake's sign · fill all 3 to finish the island
    • 🎁
      Pass the treasure chest for a lucky fire roll, coins or paws · you both get it
    • 🏝️
      Each island pays 1,000 coins each · finish all 4 for a 4,000 bonus each
    • ⏳
      The tour lasts 5 days · leftover paws turn into coins, then 3 weeks' rest
